as files get .unit.files

# each: the value alone, then with the index, then with the key
each-value
each-value tag
each-index
each-index tag
each
each-value @files
each-index @files
each @files

# map
map len_as_int
mapi index_of
mapk str_of_key
mapi @files index_of
mapk @files str_of_key

# filter
filter has_at .files
filteri index_is 1
filterk key_is lint
filteri @files index_is 0
filterk @files key_is 1

# find
find has_at .files
findi index_is 2
findk key_is lint
findi index_is 9
findk key_is absent
findi @files index_is 1
findk @files key_is 0

# reduce
reduce add --from 0.:int=0
reducei add_index --from 0.:int=0
reducek keys_so_far
reducei @files add_index --from 0.:int=10
reducek @files keys_so_far

# a callback that fails stops each form
mapi fails
mapk fails
filteri fails
filterk fails
findi fails
findk fails
reducei fails
reducek fails

# member: the member a key or an index names
member unit
member none
member absent
member @files 1
member @files 5
as dotted obj test/a.bats 0.:str="passed"
member @dotted test/a.bats
as number get .unit.runner
member @number runner
